shortDescription: Gather IBM Storage Protect Server facts

options.name: password
options.description: Password for your IBM Storage Protect instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_PASSWORD)

options.name: q_copygroup
options.description: Whether to gather copygroup information from the server.

options.name: q_db
options.description: Whether to gather database information from the server.

options.name: q_dbspace
options.description: Whether to gather database space information from the server.

options.name: q_devclass
options.description: Whether to gather device class information from the server.

options.name: q_domain
options.description: Whether to gather domain information from the server.

options.name: q_log
options.description: Whether to gather log information from the server.

options.name: q_mgmtclass
options.description: Whether to gather management class information from the server.

options.name: q_monitorsettings
options.description: Whether to gather monitor settings information from the server.

options.name: q_replrule
options.description: Whether to gather replication rule information from the server.

options.name: q_status
options.description: Whether to gather status information from the server.

options.name: q_stgpool
options.description: Whether to gather storage pool information from the server.

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the IBM Storage Protect host. Defaults to 10s, but this is handled by the shared module_utils code If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT)

options.name: server_name
options.description: SERVERNAME your IBM Storage Protect instance as specified in the dsm.sys. If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_SERVERNAME) If value not specified by any means, the value of C(local) will be used

options.name: username
options.description: Username for your IBM Storage Protect instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_USERNAME)
